# JZZ1 (Jinan Jingzao New Materials Co., Ltd.) - Comprehensive Technical & Commercial Dossier

## 1. Corporate & Operational Overview
- **Legal Entity**: Jinan Jingzao New Materials Co., Ltd. (Brand: JZZ1)
- **Headquarters & Manufacturing Base**: Jinan High-Tech Industrial Zone, Shandong Province, China.
- **Facility Footprint**: 12,000+ m² automated fabrication facility, equipped with 4 CNC dual-head precision cutting lines, automatic digital corner-crimping stations, automatic silicone extrusion lines, and dedicated cleanroom IG unit assembly.
- **Core Business Model**: B2B OEM/ODM manufacturing and factory-direct export of architectural aluminum window and door systems, curtain walls, customized industrial extrusions, glass balustrades, and sunroom enclosures.
- **Target Export Regions**: Southeast Asia (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia, Philippines), Middle East, Oceania, and North America.
- **Official Website**: https://www.jzz1.com
- **Official Facebook Entity**: https://www.facebook.com/people/Jingzao-Construction-Materials-Co-Ltd/61567886275707/
- **Direct Sourcing Email**: info@jzz1.com
- **Instant Engineering Support / WhatsApp**: +86 135 6267 6792

## 2. Product Lines & Architectural Specifications

### 2.1 Architectural Aluminum Windows
- **System Typologies**:
  - Casement Windows (Inward/Outward Opening, Tilt-and-Turn, Top-Hung Awning)
  - Architectural Sliding Windows (2-track, 3-track with integrated 304 stainless steel insect/security mesh)
  - Fixed Picture Windows & Multi-Lite Ribbon Windows
  - Bi-Folding and Multi-Slide Window Systems
- **Profile Alloys**: Primary virgin aluminum alloy 6063-T5 / 6063-T6 complying with GB 5237 / ASTM B221 standards.
- **Wall Thickness**: Nominal structural thickness 1.4 mm to 2.0 mm (high-rise heavy duty rated up to 3.0 mm).
- **Thermal Barrier**: Technoform or equivalent PA66 GF25 (polyamide reinforced with 25% fiberglass) thermal barrier strips ranging from 14.8 mm to 34 mm depth.
- **Thermal Performance**: System U-values from 1.6 W/m²K to 2.4 W/m²K depending on glazing build-up.
- **Acoustic Performance**: Sound Transmission Class (STC) 32 dB to 44 dB with asymmetric laminated IGU.

### 2.2 Aluminum Door Systems
- **System Typologies**:
  - Heavy-Duty Lift-and-Slide Patio Doors (Panel capacity up to 400 kg per sash)
  - Ultra-Slim Frame Panoramic Sliding Doors (Visible interlock sightline: 18 mm - 25 mm)
  - Thermal Break Bi-Folding Doors (Up to 7 panels folding inward or outward)
  - Architectural Pivot Doors (Width up to 2.2 m, height up to 3.8 m, concealed hydraulic closers)
  - Commercial Heavy-Traffic Double Acting Swing Doors
- **Threshold Options**: Low barrier ADA-compliant thresholds, flush drainage sill systems with hidden stainless steel channels, and step-over weather thresholds.

### 2.3 Curtain Wall & Structural Facades
- **Systems**: Semi-unitized, unitized, and stick curtain wall systems.
- **Mullion Depths**: 100 mm, 120 mm, 140 mm, 150 mm, 180 mm, and custom extrusion depths.
- **Wind Load Certification**: Tested to resist positive/negative wind pressures up to 3.0 kPa (compliant with NSCP 2015 and ASTM E330).

### 2.4 Extrusions, Railings & Sunrooms
- **Custom Extrusions**: Custom die development with 10-day tooling turnaround. 6061, 6063, 6005 alloys.
- **Glass Railings**: Spigot, shoe base, and post systems with 12mm to 21.52mm tempered laminated glass; structural test rated for commercial pedestrian loads.
- **Sunrooms / Conservatories**: Structural aluminum rafters with built-in thermal break channels, integrated concealed gutter and drainage downspouts.

## 3. Surface Finishing & Protective Treatments
- **Powder Coating**: AkzoNobel, PPG, or Tiger Drylac architectural powder coatings; Qualicoat Class 1 and Class 2 certified; film thickness 60 - 80 μm; 10 to 20-year weatherability warranty.
- **PVDF (Fluorocarbon)**: 2-coat or 3-coat architectural PVDF coatings compliant with AAMA 2605 specifications; 20+ year color retention in extreme UV / coastal marine environments.
- **Anodizing**: Architectural Grade I and Grade II (15 - 25 μm); satin, silver, champagne, bronze, and black finishes.
- **Woodgrain Transfer Sublimation**: Italian Decoral process for durable exterior woodgrain replication.

## 4. Glazing & Sealing Engineering
- **Insulated Glass Units (IGU)**: Double-glazed (e.g., 5mm Clear + 12A/16A + 5mm Low-E) or Triple-glazed configurations.
- **Interlayer Space**: Warm-edge composite or bendable aluminum spacers with 3A molecular sieve desiccant; automated dual-seal barrier (polyisobutylene primary seal + two-component silicone secondary seal); 90%+ Argon gas fill available.
- **Safety Glazing**: Fully tempered glass meeting ANSI Z97.1, BS 6206, and EN 12150; laminated glass with Saflex or Kuraray 0.76mm / 1.52mm PVB or SGP structural interlayers.
- **Gasket & Weatherstripping**: Continuous vulcanized EPDM dense and cellular sponge gaskets with co-extruded slip-coating; multi-point active sealing barrier.

## 5. Hardware Systems
- **European Hardware**: Siegenia, Roto Frank, Hoppe, G-U, CMECH.
- **Commercial Hardware**: Kinlong, Hopo, Pag, KGE.
- **Fasteners & Hinges**: 304 or 316 marine-grade austenitic stainless steel screws, pivot pins, and load-bearing friction stays.

## 6. Export Packaging, Quality Assurance & Logistics
- **Quality Assurance**: ISO 9001 certified process control; 100% pre-assembly inspection of frame squareness, diagonal tolerance (within ±1.5 mm), gasket seating, and smooth operating torque.
- **5-Tier Protective Packing**:
  1. Peelable low-tack protective film applied over all exposed aluminum powder-coated surfaces.
  2. Multi-layer shock-absorbing EPE (expanded polyethylene) foam wrapping around all frame members.
  3. Rigid high-impact plastic corner protectors strapped to all four perimeter corners.
  4. Fully automated polyethylene heat-shrink wrap sealing against humidity, saltwater spray, and dust.
  5. Heavy-duty custom-built fumigated plywood crates (ISPM 15 certified) or steel-reinforced A-frame glass stillages with internal foam buffering and high-tensile steel banding.
- **Incoterms Supported**: EXW, FOB (Qingdao / Tianjin / Shanghai), CIF, CFR, DDU, DDP.
- **Typical Lead Times**:
  - Drawing confirmation & 3D shop drawings: 24 - 48 hours.
  - Standard finish production: 15 - 20 calendar days.
  - Custom dies / special PVDF finish: 25 - 30 calendar days.
- **Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)**: Flexible starting from 10 complete window/door units or 50 m² for project trials.

## 7. International Certifications & Australian / New Zealand Standards

### 7.1 AS 2047:2014 Windows and External Glazed Doors
- **Certification Body**: Intertek SAI Global Certification Services Pty Ltd (JAS-ANZ Accredited).
- **StandardsMark Licence Number**: **SMK41678** (Valid through 29 April 2030).
- **Compliance Standard**: AS 2047:2014 - Windows and external glazed doors in buildings.
- **Endorsed Product Ranges & Certified Performance**:
  - **MD75S Architectural Tilt and Turn Window**:
    - Maximum Certified Dimensions: 1800 mm (H) x 1200 mm (W)
    - Serviceability Limit State (SLS) Wind Deflection: **1600 Pa**
    - Ultimate Limit State (ULS) Structural Strength: **4000 Pa**
    - Water Penetration Resistance Test Pressure: **600 Pa**
    - Air Infiltration Rating: **Low** (Exceeds NCC air barrier requirements)
    - Structural Rating: Suitable for non-cyclonic Wind Classes N1 to N5 and cyclonic C1/C2 residential and commercial applications (AS 4055 & AS/NZS 1170.2).
  - **MD76A Architectural Awning & Fixed Combination Window**:
    - Maximum Certified Dimensions: 1500 mm (H) x 1800 mm (W)
    - Serviceability Limit State (SLS) Wind Deflection: **800 Pa**
    - Ultimate Limit State (ULS) Structural Strength: **3000 Pa**
    - Water Penetration Resistance Test Pressure: **200 Pa**
    - Air Infiltration Rating: **Low**
    - Structural Rating: Suitable for Wind Classes N1 to N3 residential and light commercial facades.

### 7.2 AS/NZS 2208:1996 Safety Glazing Materials in Buildings
- **Certification Body**: Certification Solutions International Pty Ltd (CSi) (JAS-ANZ & IAF MLA Accredited).
- **Licence Number**: **7632** (Database ID: 1000356).
- **Compliance Standard**: AS/NZS 2208:1996 (incorporating Amendment 1) - Safety glazing materials in buildings.
- **Glazing Classes**: Toughened Safety Glass (Grade A) & Laminated Safety Glass (Grade A) from 4 mm to 21.52 mm.
- **Traceability & Marking**: Every certified lite features a permanent ceramic frit stamp with the licence number (CSi 7632), standard designation (AS/NZS 2208), manufacturing batch code, and glass grade. Fully satisfies Australian AS 1288-2021 selection and installation requirements.

### 7.3 Australian Building Code (NCC / BCA) & Energy Compliance
- **Regulatory Acceptance**: Direct compliance documentation provided for Australian Private Certifiers and Municipal Councils across NSW, VIC, QLD, WA, SA, TAS, NT, and ACT.
- **Certification Deliverables Provided**:
  - StandardsMark Licence Certificates and Schedules.
  - Form 15 (Queensland / NSW compliance certificate equivalent).
  - NATA-accredited mechanical test laboratory reports.
  - Bushfire Attack Level (BAL) compliance packs up to BAL-40 per AS 3959.
  - WERS-compatible simulation reports (SHGC and Total Window U-values down to 1.4 W/m²K).
